body:
## Confirmed current ruling, 4 October 2026

Norbert confirmed that the Quickstart v0.8 Nexus procedure is the current rule. It is settled, even if the rules may change in a future version.

- The deck has ten cards: one each numbered 1 through 7 and three blanks.
- Draw after Storm each turn.
- A number lower than the current turn number causes a Nexus.
- A blank does nothing.
- Return the drawn card and reshuffle after each check.

Use this procedure as the current rule. Do not retain older worm or full-storm-rotation triggers from superseded sources.

## Worked example

On turn three, 1 or 2 causes a Nexus. A 3, any higher number, or a blank does not. Return the card and reshuffle in either case. The chance that turn is 20%.

## Why Nexus is separate from Shai-Hulud

The separation gives Nexus events their own probability curve. The designers can tune the Shai-Hulud card count to make spice collection dangerous enough and give Fremen more mobility without also changing Nexus frequency.

## Resolution

Norbert's confirmation: "This IS how the current ruling IS. yes. It may change, but it's not an open question. The v0.8 is the correct starting point yes."

The rule and an example are now in the Central-owned Dream Rulebook draft, on A turn and the Nexus. This issue is resolved. A later proposed rules change is separate work and does not make the current rule uncertain.

Sources: Norbert's confirmation on 4 October 2026; Quickstart v0.8, Nexus Deck; current Atreides Nexus Prescience. Earlier guides explain the original conflict but do not override the confirmed rule.

Part of #1831.
title: Dreamrules ruling: Does the ten-card Nexus deck replace all other Nexus triggers?
